_readme: Things Madison shows you at the end of the day. kind: reel | plush | animal | food | shopping | baby | wild. react: haha | aww | omg (which reaction note lands on the punchline). Add your own; {baby}/{hero}/{partner} work.
openers: Okay okay okay. Look at this.
Hon, you have to see this one.
Before you fall asleep. One more. Promise.
I've been saving this one for you all day.

items.title: Cat falls off the counter, files a police report
items.line: He looks SO betrayed.

items.title: Guy proposes at Costco, gets a free sample mid-kneel
items.line: Romance is not dead. It's in aisle 9.

items.title: Raccoon steals a whole pizza, makes eye contact
items.line: That's literally our raccoon.

items.title: Dad does 'the voice' at the drive-thru
items.line: You do this. You do EXACTLY this.

items.title: Goose chases a mailman for four straight minutes
items.line: The goose is me before coffee.

items.title: Toddler argues with the smart speaker and wins
items.line: {baby} is gonna be this kid.

items.title: Line cook flips an egg one-handed, slips, still lands it
items.line: This is you. This is your whole career.

items.title: Golden retriever misses every single treat
items.line: He's trying his best!!

items.title: Man builds a dresser, finds four extra screws, panics
items.line: Remember the crib? Remember the CRIB?

items.title: Grandma reviews energy drinks. Brutal. Honest.
items.line: She gave one 'no stars, made me see God.'

items.title: Husband tries to fold a fitted sheet, gives up, buries it
items.line: This is a documentary about you.

items.title: Baby hears a sneeze, thinks it's the funniest thing ever
items.line: Do a sneeze. Do one for {baby} tomorrow.

items.title: Capybara plush in a strawberry hat
items.line: He's so calm. I want to be him.

items.title: Frog plush with a tiny backpack
items.line: Where is he GOING? Who packed his lunch?

items.title: Axolotl plush that looks personally offended
items.line: He's mad at the HOA too.

items.title: Mushroom guy plush with a little mustache
items.line: His name is Gerald. I've decided.

items.title: Shark plush that's secretly a slipper
items.line: For my feet. After the walk. Hint hint.

items.title: Ghost plush holding a boba
items.line: He's spooky but hydrated.

items.title: Cow plush wearing a frog costume
items.line: Identity crisis. Relatable.

items.title: Plush croissant with a face
items.line: I'd eat him. I'd also protect him.

items.title: Sleepy moth plush, extremely fluffy
items.line: LOOK at his little antennas.

items.title: Giant loaf-shaped cat plush, sold out everywhere
items.line: Sold out. Again. My villain origin story.

items.title: Limited-drop plush, 400 dollars on resale
items.line: Four hundred. For a PILLOW. ...I still want him.

items.title: Baby otters holding hands so they don't drift apart
items.line: That's us. Don't drift.

items.title: Puppy sees snow for the first time
items.line: His whole world just changed.

items.title: Duckling follows a cat because it thinks it's mom
items.line: The cat is TOLERATING it. Respect.

items.title: Zoo announces a baby gorilla, born last week
items.line: Look at his tiny grumpy face.

items.title: Someone made a forty-foot honey bun
items.line: I need to go there. Pack the car.

items.title: 'Black Forest cake in a mug, 3 minutes'
items.line: Yours is better. Don't let it go to your head.

items.title: Restaurant charges $38 for 'deconstructed' toast
items.line: You could do this with your eyes closed. And charge less.

items.title: Hot sauce so spicy the label is a legal waiver
items.line: Your coworkers would drink this for twenty bucks.

items.title: Onesie that says 'Tiny Line Cook'
items.line: Adding to cart. Don't stop me.

items.title: Matching pajama set for the whole family. And the cats.
items.line: Christmas card. This year. Non-negotiable.

items.title: A lamp shaped like a frog holding a mushroom
items.line: We don't need it. We NEED it.

items.title: Video from today: {baby} discovering her own feet
items.line: She was SO surprised. Like, who are these guys?

items.title: Photo: {baby} asleep with her fist in the air
items.line: She fell asleep mid-protest. Your daughter.

items.title: {baby} made a face at the pediatrician
items.line: Pure judgment. She gets that from me.

items.title: Woman finds a thousand-dollar bill in a thrift store coat
items.line: Every coat I own just got searched.

items.title: A billionaire's yacht has a smaller yacht inside it
items.line: A yacht. In a yacht. Our rent went up again.

items.title: Rent in the city: $4,800 for a 'cozy' closet
items.line: Should we... hug the landlord? ...No. Never.

items.title: Guy in Florida wrestles a gator for a cooler of beer
items.line: That's literally Palm Beach Pete.

items.title: Couple married 70 years still holds hands at breakfast
items.line: That's gonna be us. You're stuck with me.
